# Signed bundles

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:signed-bundles` · **Epic:** [#94](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/94) · **Tickets:** 5 (2S 3M)

The CP signs everything it ships to workers as one canonical bundle, and workers verify it against a pinned key before applying. A compromised network path or CP replica serving stale or forged policy can no longer change worker behavior.

## How we build it

- Bundle JSON: {version (monotonic int from policy history), issuedAt, policy (existing policyWire incl. settings and agents), blockedUsers, jwks (token keys), revocations (worker cert serials)}; canonicalized with RFC 8785 JCS before signing.
- Envelope served on existing `GET /policy`: {bundle, sig: base64url Ed25519, kid}; ETag = version; served only when `bundles.signed: true` (default true once rolled out), plain wire kept for local-only and old workers behind `bundles.legacyUnsigned`.
- Signing key from internal/keys with purpose=bundle (separate from token keys); worker pins bundle public keys via config `controlPlane.bundleKeys` (list of JWK or file) and accepts any listed kid, allowing pinned rotation.
- Worker rejects: missing/invalid sig, unknown kid, version < last applied (rollback), issuedAt more than 5m in the future; on reject keeps last-known-good, logs, increments `warden_bundle_rejected_total{reason}`, and reports the rejection in heartbeat.
- Last-known-good bundle persisted to the worker state dir (envelope + sig) so restarts re-verify and resume without the CP; fail-closed behavior until first valid bundle is preserved.

## Done when

Workers apply only bundles with a valid signature from a pinned key and a non-decreasing version, and a tampered or replayed bundle leaves the worker on its last-known-good policy.

### 1/5 · W-P2-SBND-01

**Add internal/bundle canonical format, sign and verify**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#95](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/95)

Create new package internal/bundle with Bundle struct, JCS canonicalization (RFC 8785, implemented in-package to avoid a new dependency), `Sign(b, keys.Signer) (Envelope, error)` and `Verify(env, pinned []JWK, lastVersion int64, now) (Bundle, error)` returning typed errors (ErrUnsigned, ErrBadSignature, ErrUnknownKID, ErrRollback, ErrFuture).

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] JCS output matches RFC 8785 test vectors
- [ ] Flipping one byte in policy yields ErrBadSignature
- [ ] version lower than lastVersion yields ErrRollback

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-KEYS-01`](key-management.md#15--w-p2-keys-01) Add internal/keys Signer interface and local Ed25519/ES256 signers

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-SBND-02`](signed-bundles.md#25--w-p2-sbnd-02) Serve signed bundle envelope on GET /policy; [`W-P2-SBND-03`](signed-bundles.md#35--w-p2-sbnd-03) Add bundle key pinning to worker config

### 2/5 · W-P2-SBND-02

**Serve signed bundle envelope on GET /policy**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#96](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/96)

In internal/controlplane policyServer build the Bundle from the current policy version (P1 history), blockedUsers, agents wire, token JWKS and revocation list; sign with the purpose=bundle key and cache the envelope until any input changes (policy write, key rotation, revocation, registry write all call refresh). Keep ETag long-poll semantics with ETag=version.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Key rotation produces a new bundle version and wakes long-poll waiters
- [ ] Envelope verifies with internal/bundle.Verify
- [ ] legacyUnsigned=true still serves the old wire to old workers

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-SBND-01`](signed-bundles.md#15--w-p2-sbnd-01) Add internal/bundle canonical format, sign and verify; [`W-P2-KEYS-03`](key-management.md#35--w-p2-keys-03) Implement rotation schedule with overlap window

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-SBND-04`](signed-bundles.md#45--w-p2-sbnd-04) Verify bundles in RemoteProvider and keep last-known-good

### 3/5 · W-P2-SBND-03

**Add bundle key pinning to worker config**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#97](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/97)

Add `controlPlane.bundleKeys` (inline JWKs or `bundleKeysFile`) to config.ControlPlaneConfig/rawControlPlane with validation (public only, EdDSA). A CP-managed worker with no pinned key refuses to start unless `controlPlane.allowUnsignedBundles: true` (dev only, warns).

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Missing pin fails startup with a clear error
- [ ] Private JWK in config rejected

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-SBND-01`](signed-bundles.md#15--w-p2-sbnd-01) Add internal/bundle canonical format, sign and verify

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-SBND-04`](signed-bundles.md#45--w-p2-sbnd-04) Verify bundles in RemoteProvider and keep last-known-good

### 4/5 · W-P2-SBND-04

**Verify bundles in RemoteProvider and keep last-known-good**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#98](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/98)

Change config.RemoteProvider.Pull/PollLong + parseRemotePolicy to unwrap and verify the envelope, track lastVersion, and on failure return an error that longPollControlPlane already treats as keep-last-known. Persist the last good envelope to the worker state dir and load+re-verify it at startup. Expose the verified Bundle (jwks, revocations, blockedUsers) to the applier.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Tampered bundle: worker keeps enforcing previous policy
- [ ] Rollback to an older valid bundle rejected
- [ ] Restart with CP down loads persisted bundle and enforces it

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-SBND-02`](signed-bundles.md#25--w-p2-sbnd-02) Serve signed bundle envelope on GET /policy; [`W-P2-SBND-03`](signed-bundles.md#35--w-p2-sbnd-03) Add bundle key pinning to worker config

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-SBND-05`](signed-bundles.md#55--w-p2-sbnd-05) Report bundle rejections via metrics and heartbeat; [`W-P2-SECT-04`](security-tests.md#44--w-p2-sect-04) Add worker cert and signed bundle attack cases; [`W-P2-WBND-01`](identity-enforcement.md#15--w-p2-wbnd-01) Verify CP-issued Warden tokens against bundle JWKS

### 5/5 · W-P2-SBND-05

**Report bundle rejections via metrics and heartbeat**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#99](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/99)

Add `warden_bundle_rejected_total{reason}` and `warden_bundle_version` gauge in internal/observability, and include {bundleVersion, lastRejectReason} in the heartbeat body; CP WorkerRegistry shows them in the fleet view.
